acts.desc: Host Ira Glass explains what we’re doing on today’s show.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Amy Bloom tells the story of her husband, Brian, getting Alzheimer's and wanting assisted suicide. Her search to find a way to do that led her to Dignitas, in Switzerland. Hear this intimate and frank account of the experience they go through, excerpted from her book, IN LOVE.

acts.title: Exit Strategy

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Comedian Zarna Garg tells jokes onstage about the extreme ways she tries to control her daughter Zoya’s life. Zoya explains, they’re not really jokes. Ira Glass talks to both of them about it.
acts.credits: By Ira Glass; Produced by Elna Baker
acts.title: Comedy Duo
